model_notes.caveat: 325 of 520 players matched to a real anytime-TD price this run (325 from live API; unmatched players show usage/model only, either no line posted for that player or a name-matching miss). 5 of 520 players clear the blueprint's qualification screen (Tier A/B). Screen implements the PDF's stated snap share/TD projection/red-zone role/regression checks and edge/EV tiers; matchup rating is implemented but informational only (see README); HEAT-window thresholds are named in the PDF but not formulaically defined, so not enforced. Candidate pool is last season's active players corrected for known offseason trades, PLUS any player with a live anytime-TD price this week that the usage heuristic alone would have missed (see player_td_features.py). True rookies and any very recent retirements the crosswalk hasn't caught are still not included unless they have real trailing history.
